name: AzerothCore WotLK
author: sudo-ivan@users.noreply.github.com
description: AzerothCore WotLK using the dockerized-game-servers image. Docker image: acore/ac-wotlk-worldserver:master. Persistent data is stored under /home/container (mapped from the image data directory on startup). Default ports: -3724}:3724/tcp This egg runs only the worldserver binary. MariaDB, db-import, and client-data init are still required. External image maintained outside this repository.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Server files: /mnt/server
set -e
mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server
echo "Install complete. Game files download on first container start."

variables.name: Database Root Password
variables.description: MariaDB root password used in AC_*_DATABASE_INFO strings.
